Rejecting Germany's demand to halt uranium enrichment on Sunday, Baghaei reiterated Iran's right under the NPT to the peaceful use of nuclear energy. Baghaei said Iran's right to enrich uranium was not granted by Germany, France or any other country. As an NPT party, Iran would continue to fulfill its obligations, he said. Iran did not suspend the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)'s safeguards monitoring of relevant facilities during its conflict with the United States and Israel, said Baghaei, adding that most of Iran's cooperation with the agency had been interrupted because of circumstances imposed on the country. Baghaei said Iran would not relinquish its right to peaceful nuclear energy, and it is not currently discussing the details of the nuclear issue with the United States, and cooperation between Iran and the IAEA will remain unchanged under current circumstances. Whether Iran withdraws from the NPT should be decided by the relevant Iranian authorities in accordance with legal procedures, he said.
